description: Profit per campaign across every connected ad platform: each campaign’s spend read live from the platform, joined to the brand’s own sales. Revenue per campaign comes from ONE source, strongest first: results you uploaded (upload_campaign_results), else conversion events sent through send_conversion_event and credited to campaigns under `model` (last_click default, first_touch, linear, position_based, time_decay), else Shopify / Stripe orders matched by utm_campaign. Never summed across sources, so one sale is never counted twice. Each row: spend, sales, revenue, profit (set_profit_settings), POAS, profit after ads, ROAS, cost per sale, the platform’s own reported conversions beside it, and which source the revenue came from. Money stays per currency; a platform that could not be read is named, never shown as zero. from / to (YYYY-MM-DD) or days, up to 92; platforms narrows it. Free.

includeIdle.description: true also lists campaigns with no spend and no sales

model.description: how event revenue is credited to campaigns; default last_click

platforms.description: meta, google_ads, tiktok_ads, linkedin, microsoft_ads, pinterest_ads, reddit_ads, snapchat_ads, x_ads, openai_ads, apple_ads; default every connected one

revenueFrom.description: which revenue sources to use; default all three, in that order

name: campaign_profit
title: Profit per ad campaign
